additional_info.subject: Additional Information
additional_info.body: We encountered an unexpected charging interruption on one of our stations on April 7th, 2025, around 15:10. The session was cut off without any clear reason or user intervention. We kindly request a thorough analysis of the event to determine the cause of this interruption. Please investigate any communication drops, internal errors, or safety triggers that may have led to the cut-off. This issue is critical for us, as such unpredictable behavior significantly impacts user experience and trust in the system. Looking forward to your findings and feedback.

additional_info.subject: ID0417361-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP/R4 170001753] Charging issue CRM:00315002527
additional_info.body:
Hi Florian, good afternoon.
I checked the session you provided and it seems that the EV itself stopped the session.
From our side, there is no error reported, it seems that the EV really stopped the session. Is it possible that it limits the charging to 92%?
I will patiently wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0417361-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP/R4 170001753] Charging issue CRM:00315002527
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
Thanks for your response.
However, I believe you're looking at the wrong session. The issue does not concern the one you mentioned, but the previous charging session, which stopped unexpectedly at 56% SOC with only 9 kWh added, around 15:10 on April 7th, 2025.
I understand that the session shows as SuspendedEVSE, but I can confirm that no interaction was made with the vehicle, and the charge limit was set to 100%, so the vehicle should not have stopped the charge.
Additionally, the charger screen displayed "Recharge complete", even though the battery was far from full.
Could you please double-check the correct session and provide a deeper analysis?
Best regards,
Florian MURA
Ingénieur Exploitation IRVE
ENGIE Mobilités Électriques
florian.mura@engie.com
+33 7 88 44 89 95

additional_info.subject: ID0417361-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP/R4 170001753] Charging issue CRM:00315002527
additional_info.body:
Hi Florian, good afternoon.
Thank you for sharing your concerns, it was indeed my mistake. I apologise for the misunderstanding.
The error I see is from 12:59:56 my time.
When you mentioned 15:10, I searched through the logs since 13:00 until 15:00 because the logs are shifted 2h. So I missed the session for 4 seconds.
It seems like there was a fault in the temperature sensor of the plug, we have this error mitigated in the v6.1.3.
If I have your permission I can install v6.1.3 in this charger and if this error happens again then we need to send the field technicians to perform some extra troubleshooting.
Let me know your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

Mr. Florian reported a CableTempSensor error which is the 15ºC limit. If we update the charger to v6.1.3 it will most likely fix it. If after the update the error is still appearing then we need to replace the CCS cable. He is not replying to any of my messages since a few days ago but I don't want to update without his permission. Please have a word with him.
